description:
An adjuster is going to a residence on the ninth floor this afternoon to close an account that has been in arrears for a year, and she would like somebody in the corridor while she does it.

Not to come in. Not to be introduced. Not to intervene, she is quite firm about that, and she is firm about it early.

"He will not take it well and it will not last long," she says, checking the floor number against a card she does not need to check. "Nobody will remember me. They remember the corridor."

fail_on.desc: Somebody looked straight at you. An adjuster who is remembered is not an adjuster.
It reached a camera. Halcyon can settle a great many things, but not a recording.

name: Adjuster

objectives.desc: Get up to the ninth floor and take the corridor.
emotes: {who} finds a doorway with a good angle on the corridor and stops being a person in a corridor.
{who} hears the first two minutes go quite well, which is the part nobody warns you about.

objectives.desc: Pull the account record while the adjuster is inside.
emotes: {who} works the panel with the sound of a conversation changing register on the other side of a wall.
{who} gets the record, and reads the date the account went into arrears, and does the arithmetic without meaning to.
